en.specs.title: The real numbers, straight from the listing
en.s1.b: LED light with 16 RGB colors and Flash / Strobe / Fade / Smooth effects - switch from cosy to calm to party with one remote button.
en.s2.b: The lamp head turns a full 360°, letting you aim the light onto a curtain, wall or ceiling and shape the glow you want.
en.s3.b: Dial the brightness from the remote to suit the room - with party-ready effects on tap any time.
en.s4.t: A thicker lens and wider angle
en.s4.b: The thicker crystal lens and wider angle throw a richly detailed sunset onto the wall - clearer and bigger than ordinary projectors.
en.s5.b: High-quality aluminium + silica + PVC with a stable base, a non-slip pad and a cotton layer that protects your floor from scratches.
en.s6.b: A 5 W energy-efficient LED with no harsh glare and a long service life - runs off a USB port on a power bank or laptop.
